questions.question: In ΔABC, ∠C = 90° and CD is perpendicular to AB at D. If AD/BD = √k, then AC/BC = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb8b3a3a5063dd91b4c2998e235160d3b685d55d935a0f916594f0c672f8fc57.png] 

In ΔABC and ΔACD

∠ACB = ∠CDA,

∠CAD = ∠CAB

⇒ ΔABC ∼ ΔACD

⇒ AC/AB = AD/AC

⇒ AC² = AB × AD ----(1)

Similary,

In ΔCBD and ΔABC

⇒ ΔCBD ∼ ΔABC

⇒ BC/BA = BD/BC

⇒ BC² = BA × BD ----(2)

From (1) and (2),

⇒ AC²/BC² = (AB × AD)/(BA × BD)

⇒ (AC/BC)² = AD/BD

⇒ (AC/BC)² = √k

⇒ AC/BC = ∜k

 If ABC is a right-angled triangle and CD⊥ AB we have,

⇒ AD/BD = (AC/BC)²

⇒ √k = (AC/BC)2

⇒ (AC/BC) = (√k)¹/² = ∜k

**∴ The correct answer is ∜k.**

questions.question: PT is a tangent at the point R on a circle with centre O. SQ is a diameter, which when produced meets the tangent PT at P. If ∠SPT = 32°, then what will be the measure of ∠QRP?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a72a08f385c1faa6da2b993db63f84a13287b49614061b31243b22fd5fa4a6d8.png] 

Given, ∠SPT = 32°

As we know,

OR is perpendicular to PT, so ∠ORP = 90°

Suppose ∠QRP = θ

As we know, sum of two interior opposite angles of a triangle is equal to its exterior angle.

∠OQR = 32° + θ

∠OQR = ∠ORQ = 32° + θ [same radii]

Now,

∠ORP = ∠ORQ + QRP

90° = 32° + θ + θ

2θ = 90° – 32° = 58°

θ = 58/2 = 29°

So, ∠QRP = 29°

questions.question: If x + y + z = 1, xy + yz + zx = – 26 and x³ + y³ + z³ = 151, then what will be the value of xyz?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x + y + z = 1, xy + yz + zx = – 26, and x3 + y3 + z3 = 151

**Formula used:**

x3 + y3 + z3 – 3xyz = (x + y + z)(x2 + y2 + z2 – xy – yz – zx)

x³ + y³ + z³ – 3xyz = (x + y + z)[(x + y + z)² – 3 (xy + yz + zx)]

**Calculation:**

x3 + y3 + z3 – 3xyz = (x + y + z)[(x + y + z)2 – 3 (xy + yz + zx)]

⇒ 151 – 3xyz = 1 [1² – 3 × ( – 26)]

⇒ 151 – 3xyz = 1 + 78 = 79

⇒ 3xyz = 151 – 79 = 72

⇒ xyz = 72/3 = 24

**∴ The value of xyz is 24.**

questions.question: The volume of a solid right circular cone is 600π cm³, and the diameter of its base is 30 cm. The total surface area (in cm²) of the cone is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The volume of a solid right circular cone is 600π cm³.

Radius of cone r = 30/2 = 15 cm

**Formula used:**

The volume of cone = 1over3πr²h

**Calculation:**

The volume of cone = 1over3πr2h

⇒ 1over3 × π × 15 × 15 × h = 600π

⇒​ h = (600 × 3)/(15 × 15)

⇒​ h = 8 cm

⇒​ l² = r² + h²

⇒​ l² = 15² + 8² = 225 + 64 = 289

⇒​ l = √289 = 17 cm

Total surface area = πr(r + l)

⇒​ π × 15 × (15 + 17)

⇒​ π × 15 × 32 = 480π cm².

questions.question: If a + b + c = 6 and a² + b² + c² = 38, then what is the value of a(b² + c²) + b(c² + a²) + c(a² + b²) + 3abc?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

a + b + c = 6

a² + b² + c² = 38

**Formula Used:**

(a + b + c)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca

a3 + b3 + c3 – 3abc = (a + b + c)(a2 + b2 + c2 – ab – bc – ca)

**Calculation:**

(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca

⇒ 6² = 38 + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca

⇒ (ab + bc + ca) = (36 – 38)/2

⇒ (ab + bc + ca) = – 1

a(b² + c²) + b(c² + a²) + c(a² + b²) + 3abc = a(38 – a²) + b(38 – b²) + c(38 – c²) + 3abc

⇒ 38a + 38b + 38c – (a³ + b³ + c³) + 3abc

⇒ 38(a + b + c) – {(a³ + b³ + c³) – 3abc}

⇒ (38 × 6) – {(a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² – ab – bc – ca)}

⇒ (38 × 6) – {6 × (38 – (–1))}

⇒ (38 × 6) – 6 × 39

⇒ 6(38 – 39)

⇒ -6

**∴ The value of a(b2 + c2) + b(c2 + a2) + c(a2 + b2) + 3abc is -6.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

a + b + c = 6 and a² + b² + c² = 38

As we know, there are three variable but only 2 equation is given so 1 variable will be 0, so

Put c = 0, then

a + b = 6 and a² + b² = 38

As we know,

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

⇒ 6² = 38 + 2ab

⇒ 2ab = 36 – 38

⇒ 2ab = –2

⇒ ab = –2/2

⇒ ab = –1

Now,

a(b² + c²) + b(c² + a²) + c(a² + b²) + 3abc

Put c = 0, then

⇒ ab² + ba²

⇒ ab(a + b)

⇒ (-1) × 6

⇒ -6

∴ The value of a(b2 + c2) + b(c2 + a2) + c(a2 + b2) + 3abc is -6.

questions.question: The total numbers of students in sections A and B of a class are 72. The ratio of the number of students in A and B is 7 : 5. The average weight (in kg) of the students in section B is 20% more than that of the students in section A. If the average weight of all the students in the class is 52 kg, then what is the average weight (in kg) of the students in section B?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The total numbers of students in sections A and B of a class are 72.

The ratio of the number of students in A and B is 7 : 5.

The average weight (in kg) of the students in section B is 20% more than that of the students in section A.

The average weight of all the students in the class is 52 kg,

**Formula used:**

Average = sum of observations/Number of observations

**Calculation:**

The number of students = 72

Number of students in section A = 72 × (7/12) = 42

Number of students in section B = 72 – 42 = 30

Let the average weight of section A be 5x

Average weight of section B = 5x × (6/5) = 6x

According to the question

42 × 5x + 30 × 6x = 72 × 52

210x + 180x = 3744

390x = 3744

x = 3744/390 = 9.6

Average weight of students in section B = 6x = 6 × 9.6 = 57.6

**∴ The average weight (in kg) of the students in section B is 57.6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Let the number of students in sections A and B are 7 and 5 respectively.

Let the average weight of section A be 5x.

Average weight of section B = 5x × (6/5) = 6x

According to the question

7 × 5x + 5 × 6x = 12 × 52

35x + 30x = 12 × 52

65x = 12 × 52

x = (12 × 52)/65 = 9.6

Average weight of section B = 9.6 × 6 = 57.

questions.question: The total surface area of a solid hemisphere is 1039.5 cm². The volume (in cm³) of the hemisphere is: (Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

TSA of hemisphere = 1039.5 cm²

**Formula used:**

Total surface area of the hemisphere = 3πr²

Volume of the hemisphere = (2/3) × πr³

**Calculation:**

⇒ 3πr² = 1039.5

⇒ 3 × (22/7) × r² = 1039.5

⇒ r² = (1039.5 × 7)/(3 × 22) = 15.75 × 7 = 2.25 × 7 × 7

⇒ r = 1.5 × 7 = 10.5

Volume of the hemisphere = (2/3) × π r³ = (2/3) × (22/7) × 10.5 × 10.5 × `10.5 = 2425.5

**∴ The correct answer is 2425.5**

questions.solution:
Ratio of capitals invested by A, B and C = 2/5 : 3/4 : 5/8 = 16 : 30 : 25

Let capital of A, B and C are 16x, 30x and 25x respectively.

Capital of A at the end of the year = 16x × 4 + 24x × 8 = 64x + 192x = 256x

Capital of B at the end of the year = 30x × 4 + 24x × 8 = 120x + 192x = 312x

Capital of C at the end of the year = 25x × 12 = 300x

Capital ratio of A, B and C at the end of the year = 256x : 312x : 300x = 64x : 78x : 75x

According to the question

64x + 78x + 75x = 282100

217x = 282100

x = 282100/217 = 1300

Profit share of B at the end of the year = 78x = 78 × 1300 = 101400

questions.question: The average of ten numbers is 72. The average of the first four numbers is 69 and that of the next three numbers is 74. The 8th number is 6 more than the 9th number and 12 more than the 10th number. What is the average of the 8th and 9th numbers?
questions.solution:
Average of 10 numbers = 72

Sum of 10 numbers = 72 × 10 = 720

Average of first four numbers = 69

Sum of first four numbers = 69 × 4 = 276

Average of next 3 numbers = 74

Sum of next 3 numbers = 74 × 3 = 222

Sum of 8th, 9th and 10th numbers = 720 – 276 – 222 = 222

Let 8th number be x

9th number be x – 6

10th number be x – 12

According to question

x + x – 6 + x – 12 = 222

3x – 18 = 222

3x = 222 + 18

3x = 240

x = 240/3

x = 80

8th number = 80

9th number = 80 – 6 = 74

Average of 8th and 9th number = (80 + 74)/2 = 154/2 = 77

**Alternate Method:**

Average of 10 number = 72

Deviation of first four numbers = (72 – 69) × 4 = 3 × 4 = 12

Deviation of next three numbers = (72 – 74) × 3 = ( – 2) × 3 = – 6

Sum of last three numbers = 72 × 3 + 12 – 6 = 216 + 6 = 222

Let 8th number be x

9th number be x – 6

10th number be x – 12

According to question

x + x – 6 + x – 12 = 222

3x – 18 = 222

3x = 222 + 18

3x = 240

x = 240/3

x = 80

8th number = 80

9th number = 80 – 6 = 74

Average of 8th and 9th number = (80 + 74)/2 = 154/2 = 7
